Package index

Grain decisions

The grain-semantics verbs – each wraps decideR’s engine with grain meaning and returns a grain_decision.

plan_nitrogen_rate()
Plan a nitrogen rate for a grain crop
plan_nitrogen_rate_from_manifest()
Plan a nitrogen rate from an upstream orchestra manifest
plan_variety()
Plan a variety choice from a multi-environment trial or genomic posterior
plan_variety_from_manifest()
Plan a variety choice from a breeding-values manifest
plan_grade_target()
Plan a grade target under a quality-band payoff

The orchestrator

Compose grain decisions into a provenance-carrying season plan.

plan_season()
Compose grain decisions into a season plan
grain_plan_table()
Summarise a grain plan as a data frame

Grain value library

Reusable, documented grain value and loss schedules built from published grade conventions.

wheat_protein_bands()
Wheat protein-band value schedule
barley_malting_premium()
Barley malting-premium value schedule
n_rate_economics()
Nitrogen-rate economics

Result objects

The S7 result types and their predicate.

grain_decision()
A grain decision – a recommended grain action with context and grounding
grain_plan()
A grain plan – an ordered season of grain decisions with combined grounding
grain_is_grounded()
Is a grain decision or plan grounded?
print.grain_decision
Print a grain decision
print.grain_plan
Print a grain plan
print(<n_rate_economics>)
Print nitrogen-rate economics
